sourceCommitReference: See RELEASE_MANIFEST_v0.10.1.json and the v0.10.1 tag.

checks: Research bulk render uses the visible shared style/font/duration/images and MC, retaining Research and its selection
Render and Research share preferences; compact and expanded per-story rendering use the same choices
LLM-to-render also uses the selection; old batch style and Retry remain immutable; completed video previews inside Research
Save errors block sending a mismatched configuration; retry and rapid edits persist the last choice; projects remain independent
Preferences survive a real server restart at a new port and a clean browser context; desktop/mobile have no overflow
Fresh project defaults to V3, with standard/fast/classic choices
All three selections reach the submitted request and survive reload
Old saved preferences acquire V3 without resetting duration/image count
Product rendering does not receive a news style control
Research & News stays visible with an existing result and has no blank-screen error
Settings Test LLM sends the current unsaved endpoint and API key
Research retains the selected source and visible render record without leaving the Research workspace
Left navigation has an independent mouse-scroll region on short windows
Channels workspace imports a local Page through the current ID/CSV/JSON dialog
Post management opens in its own tab without duplicate warehouse rows
News Content stores first comment and source link
Product Studio queues a DreamFace video request
Render workspace switches between News and Product and exposes the direct-link and three style presets
Bulk DreamFace slots create local rotation profiles without external email creation
Separated workspaces have no console errors or horizontal overflow
Compact rows, partial page checkbox, cross-page selection and page-size changes preserve exact selection
Select-all targets only current filter, clear works, changing filter clears previous selection
One confirmed API request deletes selected idle stories and preserves both active stages, other projects and existing jobs
Legacy single-delete API also rejects a story still preparing before job creation
Per-story delete supports cancellation and removes only its target even when other stories are selected
Bulk render submits exactly the selected eligible stories, per-story counts and MC, skipping active story
Quick single render uses selected MC; per-story settings expand; desktop/mobile remain usable without script errors
Default work view hides completed history; counts and pagination match 30 stories
Search, quality filter and bulk render target only the matching story
Mixed selection renders only selected unfinished idle stories, skipping completed and running ones
Published cleaned video remains in history; available final video opens with playable metadata
Failure opens the correct batch; live SSE completion updates filters and prevents duplicate render while active
Desktop and narrow layout have no horizontal overflow or JavaScript errors
Editable 100-story request researches 100 distinct sources through real local HTTP, persists progress and selects that research run
100-story render submits one ordered batch, repeats MC 10/20 across story boundaries and saves separate AI/render concurrency
Direct News production supports 100 videos and MC rotation
One research story can produce 100 versions with a 15/5 MC cycle
Rotation controls fit narrow screens without JavaScript errors
Electron Queue completion plays the correct final MP4 inline, advances time and seeks without opening a popup
Reveal targets the exact physical video file through the data junction
Library defaults to three final outputs and separates Page avatars, MC stills and raw presenter clips
Source-age filter distinguishes old news from newly completed renders and displays source date separately
Research individual story sends the selected MC and requested three videos, separate from the provider profile
Research bulk render sends one common MC and two videos per selected unfinished story
Importing an MC image immediately selects it and stores it under the MC group
Packaged server/shared/desktop/frontend/fonts match the reviewed working tree
Offline captions, model and licenses are bundled byte-for-byte
Native Research bulk render uses visible V3 Fast and font, remains in Research, and shows immutable new/old batch styles
Native Render and Research share persisted choices after reload; isolated data and sandboxed renderer verified

installedUpgrade.note: Opening the existing timeline editor autosaves identical timeline content and updates project.updatedAt. Every other persisted value was verified unchanged.

scope.providers: No paid MC or LLM request used for validation; submission bodies were intercepted in isolated workspaces.
scope.publishing: No social post was published by verification scripts.
scope.platform: Windows x64; NVIDIA RTX 3060 and explicit CPU mode tested. AMD/Intel GPUs not physically tested.
scope.performance: The V3 renderer is unchanged. GPU and CPU diagnostic inputs differ and are not a speed comparison.
scope.captions: Bundled English ASR is used for timing anchors; low confidence falls back to estimated timing with a visible warning.
